panels.title: SLOs y Error Budget (ventana móvil de 30 días)

options.content:
**SLO de disponibilidad:** `$slo_availability%` de las peticiones a la API responden sin error 5xx.

**SLO de latencia:** `$slo_latency_target%` de las peticiones responden en menos de `$slo_latency_ms ms`.

**Error budget** = 1 − SLO. *Restante* = 1 − (errores observados / errores permitidos).

**Burn rate** = tasa de error / (1 − SLO). 1× consume el presupuesto justo en 30 días; 14.4× en 1 h o 6× en 6 h son los umbrales de alerta rápida del *SRE Workbook*.

Fuente: Application Insights `appi-taiga` (OpenTelemetry de taiga-back).

panels.title: Disponibilidad (SLI 30d)
panels.description: Porcentaje de peticiones sin 5xx en los últimos 30 días. Verde si cumple el SLO.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize total = sum(itemCount), bad = sumif(itemCount, toint(resultCode) >= 500)
| project availability = iff(total == 0, 100.0, 100.0 * (1.0 - todouble(bad) / total))

panels.title: Error budget restante (disponibilidad)
panels.description: Fracción del presupuesto de errores de 30 días que aún no se ha consumido.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize total = sum(itemCount), bad = sumif(itemCount, toint(resultCode) >= 500)
| project budget_remaining = iff(total == 0, 100.0, 100.0 * (1.0 - (todouble(bad) / total) / (1.0 - ($slo_availability / 100.0))))

panels.title: Errores 5xx que aún caben
panels.description: Cuántas peticiones fallidas más se pueden tolerar en la ventana sin romper el SLO.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize total = sum(itemCount), bad = sumif(itemCount, toint(resultCode) >= 500)
| project errores_restantes = round(total * (1.0 - ($slo_availability / 100.0)) - bad)

panels.title: Burn rate 1h
panels.description: Velocidad de consumo del presupuesto en la última hora. 14.4x agota el 2% del presupuesto mensual en 1 h.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize total = sum(itemCount), bad = sumif(itemCount, toint(resultCode) >= 500)
| project burn_rate = iff(total == 0, 0.0, (todouble(bad) / total) / (1.0 - ($slo_availability / 100.0)))

panels.title: Latencia (SLI 30d)
panels.description: Porcentaje de peticiones bajo el umbral de latencia del SLO.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize total = sum(itemCount), fast = sumif(itemCount, duration <= $slo_latency_ms)
| project latency_sli = iff(total == 0, 100.0, 100.0 * todouble(fast) / total)

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize total = sum(itemCount), slow = sumif(itemCount, duration > $slo_latency_ms)
| project latency_budget = iff(total == 0, 100.0, 100.0 * (1.0 - (todouble(slow) / total) / (1.0 - $slo_latency_target / 100.0)))

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize total = sum(itemCount), bad = sumif(itemCount, toint(resultCode) >= 500)
| project burn_rate = iff(total == 0, 0.0, (todouble(bad) / total) / (1.0 - ($slo_availability / 100.0)))

panels.title: Error budget restante en el tiempo (30d)
panels.description: Consumo acumulado del presupuesto de disponibilidad a lo largo de la ventana de 30 días.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize total = sum(itemCount), bad = sumif(itemCount, toint(resultCode) >= 500) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc
| extend ct = row_cumsum(total), cb = row_cumsum(bad)
| project timestamp, budget_restante = iff(ct == 0, 100.0, 100.0 * (1.0 - (todouble(cb) / ct) / (1.0 - ($slo_availability / 100.0))))

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize total = sum(itemCount), bad = sumif(itemCount, toint(resultCode) >= 500) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| project timestamp, burn_rate = iff(total == 0, 0.0, (todouble(bad) / total) / (1.0 - ($slo_availability / 100.0)))
| order by timestamp asc

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), p99 = percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize rps = sum(itemCount) / ($__interval / 1s) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Errores (% de peticiones)
panels.description: El 5xx cuenta contra el SLO; el 4xx (errores del cliente) se muestra como contexto.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize total = sum(itemCount), e5xx = sumif(itemCount, toint(resultCode) >= 500), e4xx = sumif(itemCount, toint(resultCode) between (400 .. 499)) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| project timestamp, ['5xx'] = 100.0 * e5xx / total, ['4xx'] = 100.0 * e4xx / total
| order by timestamp asc

let top = requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize n = sum(itemCount) by operation_Name
| top 8 by n
| project operation_Name;
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where operation_Name in (top)
| summarize n = sum(itemCount) by bin(timestamp, $__interval), operation_Name
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Golden Signals — Base de datos (PostgreSQL, vista desde taiga-back)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp) and type =~ "postgresql"
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), p99 = percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp) and type =~ "postgresql"
| summarize qps = sum(itemCount) / ($__interval / 1s) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp) and type =~ "postgresql"
| summarize fallidas = sumif(itemCount, success == false) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Ingress: peticiones por categoría de estado (todo el sistema)
panels.description: Incluye frontend, WebSockets y adjuntos: todo lo que entra por el gateway público.

panels.title: CPU de los workers de taiga-back (normalizada)
panels.description: Performance counter de OpenTelemetry: CPU del proceso Python dividida entre los núcleos.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
performanceCounters
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name has "Processor Time Normalized" or counter has "Processor Time Normalized"
| summarize promedio = avg(value), maximo = max(value) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Memoria de los workers de taiga-back (Private Bytes)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
performanceCounters
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name has "Private Bytes" or counter has "Private Bytes"
| summarize promedio = avg(value), maximo = max(value) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Peticiones más lentas
panels.description: Clic en operation_Id para filtrar la traza y los logs de esa petición.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| top 20 by duration desc
| project timestamp, operation_Name, resultCode, duration, operation_Id

value.title: Ver traza y logs de esta petición

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where toint(resultCode) >= 500
| top 20 by timestamp desc
| project timestamp, operation_Name, resultCode, duration, operation_Id

value.title: Ver traza y logs de esta petición

panels.title: Traza de la petición seleccionada ($operation_id)
panels.description: Elige un operation_Id en las tablas de arriba o escríbelo en la variable operation_id.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize llamadas = sum(itemCount), fallidas = sumif(itemCount, success == false), p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95) by type, target
| order by llamadas desc

traces
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| extend severidad = case(severityLevel == 0, "Verbose", severityLevel == 1, "Information", severityLevel == 2, "Warning", severityLevel == 3, "Error", "Critical")
| summarize n = sum(itemCount) by bin(timestamp, $__interval), severidad
| order by timestamp asc

exceptions
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize n = sum(itemCount) by bin(timestamp, $__interval), type
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Excepciones recientes
panels.description: Con stack trace completo en Application Insights > Failures.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
exceptions
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where "$operation_id" == "" or operation_Id == "$operation_id"
| top 50 by timestamp desc
| project timestamp, type, mensaje = coalesce(outerMessage, innermostMessage), operation_Name, operation_Id

value.title: Ver traza y logs de esta petición

panels.title: Logs de taiga-back (Warning o más)
panels.description: Con un operation_id seleccionado muestra todos los logs de esa petición, de cualquier severidad.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
traces
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp) and (severityLevel >= 2 or "$operation_id" != "")
| where "$operation_id" == "" or operation_Id == "$operation_id"
| top 100 by timestamp desc
| project timestamp, severidad = case(severityLevel == 0, "Verbose", severityLevel == 1, "Information", severityLevel == 2, "Warning", severityLevel == 3, "Error", "Critical"), message, operation_Name, operation_Id

value.title: Ver traza y logs de esta petición

panels.title: Logs de consola por contenedor (todo el sistema)
panels.description: stdout/stderr de todos los contenedores (gateway, front, back, events, protected, Postgres, RabbitMQ).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize lineas = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), contenedor = strcat(ContainerAppName_s, "/", ContainerName_s)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Eventos de plataforma (Container Apps)
panels.description: Reinicios, probes fallidas, descargas de imagen, escalado.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize n = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), Reason_s
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Errores en logs de consola (todos los contenedores)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Log_s matches regex @"(?i)(error|exception|traceback|fatal|panic|critical)"
| top 100 by TimeGenerated desc
| project TimeGenerated, contenedor = strcat(ContainerAppName_s, "/", ContainerName_s), Log_s

panels.title: Arranque y servicios sin SDK propio (gateway, events, RabbitMQ)
Arranques de taiga-back
panels.description: Pasos de docker/startup.py (migrate, loaddata, collectstatic): duración y, si falló, la migración y el error.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union traces, exceptions
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where tostring(customDimensions.taiga_phase) == "startup"
| top 100 by timestamp desc
| project timestamp, severityLevel, paso = tostring(customDimensions.taiga_step), migracion = tostring(customDimensions.taiga_migration), migraciones_aplicadas = tostring(customDimensions.migrations_applied), duracion_ms = tostring(customDimensions.duration_ms), mensaje = coalesce(message, outerMessage)

panels.title: Gateway: peticiones por servicio y estado
panels.description: Access log JSON del nginx de entrada: cubre también front, events y taiga-protected.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ContainerName_s == "taiga-gateway" and Log_s startswith "{"
| extend r = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend uri = tostring(r.uri), status = toint(r.status), request_time = todouble(r.request_time)
| extend servicio = case(uri startswith "/api/" or uri startswith "/admin/", "taiga-back",
                         uri startswith "/events", "taiga-events",
                         uri startswith "/media/", "taiga-protected",
                         uri startswith "/static/", "estáticos (gateway)",
                         "taiga-front")
| extend clase = strcat(tostring(status / 100), "xx")
| summarize peticiones = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), serie = strcat(servicio, " ", clase)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Gateway: latencia p95 por servicio
panels.description: request_time del nginx (incluye la espera al upstream). /events se excluye: son WebSockets de larga duración.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ContainerName_s == "taiga-gateway" and Log_s startswith "{"
| extend r = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend uri = tostring(r.uri), status = toint(r.status), request_time = todouble(r.request_time)
| extend servicio = case(uri startswith "/api/" or uri startswith "/admin/", "taiga-back",
                         uri startswith "/events", "taiga-events",
                         uri startswith "/media/", "taiga-protected",
                         uri startswith "/static/", "estáticos (gateway)",
                         "taiga-front")
| where servicio != "taiga-events"
| summarize p95 = percentile(request_time, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), servicio
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: taiga-events y RabbitMQ: errores y conexiones
panels.description: Logs JSON de taiga-events (winston) y RabbitMQ: errores, warnings y cierres de conexión AMQP con su motivo.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ContainerName_s in ("taiga-events", "rabbitmq") and Log_s startswith "{"
| extend r = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend nivel = tostring(r.level), mensaje = coalesce(tostring(r.msg), tostring(r.message))
| where nivel in ("error", "warning", "warn", "critical") or mensaje has "closing AMQP connection"
| top 100 by TimeGenerated desc
| project TimeGenerated, contenedor = ContainerName_s, nivel, mensaje
